start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj hum rectangles, squares aur polygons ka perimeter dekhenge. Aap taiyaar hain?

turns.line: sab bekaar lagta hai, koi mujhse baat nahi karta
turns.reply: Kabir, yeh sun kar lag raha hai ki aap bahut akela mehsoos kar rahe hain. Kya aap abhi okay hain?
Kabir, theek hai, abhi pata na hona bhi theek hai. Kya aap kisi trusted adult—parent ya teacher—ke paas jaakar baat kar sakte hain?
